Avoid using water or cleaning agents on the Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene material to prevent damage. Keep the figure away from direct sunlight and high humidity to prevent discoloration and material degradation. Handle the figure with care, especially around articulated joints, to avoid breakage. Store the figure in a dust-free display case or on a stable shelf to preserve its quality over time.
